subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Pankaj always tries his best to uphold the __reputation__ of his institution.
solution:
The correct answer is **"prestige"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here we will see the meaning of the given synonym:

__
 
• **Reputation -** the opinion that people in general have about someone or something, or how much respect or admiration someone or something receives, based on past behaviour or character

 
 
• ***Eg. ***The company has a worldwide *reputation* for quality.
 
 
 
• **Prestige -** respect and admiration given to someone or something, usually because of a reputation for high quality, success, or social influence
 
 
• ***Eg. ***The company has gained international* prestige.​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__We will be learning the meaning of other words:

 
• **Opinion -** a thought or belief about something or someone:

 ***​Eg. ***What's your* opinion* about the matter?
 
• **Position -** the place where something or someone is, often in relation to other things:
 
 
• ***​Eg.*** Well, I've found our *position* on the map if you want to see where we are.?
 
 
 
• **Growth -** The growth of a person, animal, or plant is its process of increasing in size:
 
 
• ​***Eg. ***A balanced diet is essential for healthy *growth.*
